description: Oil and gas infrastructure 1963 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Sawsene Nejjar. Shapefiles showing locations and boundaries of oil-producing regions; exploration and production wells; locations and boundaries of natural gas-producing areas; pipelines for transporting oil and gas; refineries. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
